description: This file defines a Twig extension class named YieldNotReadyExtension, which adds a node visitor related to yield not-ready handling in Twig's templating engine.

classes.name: Twig\Extension\YieldNotReadyExtension
classes.description: A Twig extension class providing a node visitor for handling yield not-ready scenarios, marked for internal use and scheduled for removal in Twig 4.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the extension with a boolean indicating whether to use yield.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Returns an array containing a new YieldNotReadyNodeVisitor instance configured with the $useYield property.
